text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the birthday present! That 
aroma set is really wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see. If you like it, that is all that 
matters.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, every time I return to my 
room, I feel so refreshed!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The scent of flowers is often quite 
soothing to the soul, after all.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Ah, is that what they call aromatherapy?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
By the way, may I ask why you chose 
lavender and mint?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Both scents are supposedly good for nasal 
congestion. You're always troubled by it, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I see! ...Thank you. You're always so 
thoughtful and attentive.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Then as a return gift, can I 
give you these weeding shears?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A return gift? What are you saying? Today 
is your birthday—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wait, hold on. ...Did you already know?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, was I right? The plastic part was 
starting to fall apart, wasn't it? I 
noticed it looked tricky to handle!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief. She's never one to be 
underestimated.
